sentences.text: Ogmodirus is an extinct genus of plesiosaur characterized by an extremely long neck that lived during the Cretaceous.
The species was originally named Ogmodirus martini by Williston and Moodie in 1913, though the specific name was later emended to martinii.
A second species, Ogmodirus ischiadicus, was initially placed in its own genus but has since been referred to Styxosaurus.
Welles (1962) suggested Ogmodirus may belong to the Elasmosauridae, but noted the genus is dubious beyond the suborder Plesiosauria due to fossil condition.
Sepkoski (2002) assigned Ogmodirus to the Plesiosauria without a more specific classification.
This animal lived during the Turonian stage, between 93.9 and 89.8 million years ago.
